purpose: Independent held-out questions for the intent classifier (trained_models/chatbot_nlp.joblib). Never add these to data/chatbot_intents.json; scripts/evaluate_intents.py reports any overlap with the training patterns.
provenance: Author-written on 2026-10-31, before the training-data additions of the same day; English, Tagalog and Taglish. Not reviewed by a second person.
